When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] and his companions escaped a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Boat/Legends|galley]] in a [[lifeboat]], the galley's owner, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]], unleashed a pair of [[Drone/Legends|drones]] to stop them. In the ensuing '''skirmish''' over the [[Roon Sea]], Baobab manned the deck [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and shot down the drones. Governor Koong's ship then approached them while a Whirlpool was near the area. Mungo and his friend tossed out all of their cargo, including Mungo's [[roonstone]]s, in order to escape the whirlpool's pull on their ship.
